faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri (MPKV) for various research and field projects.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include Senior Research Fellow and Field Labour under the DBT Chickpea Network Mission Project.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available across the Senior Research Fellow and Field Labour positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form along with required documents is 27-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for MPKV Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must send their filled applications by post or hand delivery.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. or M.Sc. (Agri.) in Genetics and Plant Breeding, Seed Technology, or Plant Physiology.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Research Fellow post will receive a salary of Rs. 42,000 plus 9% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be based on an interview conducted by the selection committee at the MPKV Rahuri office.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to The Principal Investigator, DBT Chickpea Network Mission Project, Pulses Improvement Project, M.P.K.V., Rahuri Pin- 413 722, Dist.- Ahilyanagar, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee has been prescribed or mentioned in the official notification for applying to these temporary posts.
